narration: Four signs someone is manipulating you. Number three is the most common.
One. Love bombing. Extreme affection in week one is a lever, not luck.
Two. Guilt trips. You keep apologizing for things you never did.
Three. Gaslighting. That never happened — until you start doubting your own memory.
Four. Foot in the door. Tiny favors first. They test your boundaries one yes at a time.
One concept a day, so it never works on you.
